title: Upper bound for low degree subsets
statement: Let $J$ be a subset of a finite set and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. The number of subsets of $J$ having size at most $k$ is at most $(k+1)(|J|+1)^k$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite subset of the coordinate set $[n]$
